sections.overview: This South American sheet-weaver is the sole accepted species in the genus Cryptolinyphia.
sections.identification: The original 1991 description is based on a female specimen and illustrates diagnostic anatomy.
sections.habitat: The World Spider Catalog records the species from Colombia, but does not summarize its finer habitat.
sections.diet: Species-specific prey observations were not found in the catalog entry or original description.
sections.behavior: Published material is taxonomic, and the sources reviewed do not establish its daily activity pattern.
sections.reproduction: Only a female is known from the original description; courtship, egg production and development are undocumented.
sections.ecology: Its only genus-level comparison is with other Linyphiidae; no living congener is currently accepted.
sections.conservation: The consulted sources provide no conservation assessment; missing assessment data do not establish safety.
